title: conv.color2rgba
description: `conv.color2rgba` converts a supported named color, full hexadecimal color value (`#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`), or color data into separate red, green, blue, and alpha channel values. Its output mode defaults to integer values in the 0–255 range; use `@float` for values in the 0–1 range, and `@pack` to output the channels as a list from the first outlet.
